We provide AI‑powered IT solutions, web development, design, and digital marketing services all under one roof, enabling clients to avoid juggling multiple agencies and instead work with a single, integrated technology partner.
   

  

 Role SummaryWe are seeking an experienced QA Executive with professional experience in testing websites, web applications, and mobile apps. The candidate must have a strong understanding of functional and UI/UX testing, with hands\-on experience in platforms such as WordPress, Magento, Shopify, and mobile apps (iOS/Android). The role demands excellent attention to detail, clear communication skills, and a structured, process‑oriented approach to testing.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities Test Planning \& Execution Prepare and execute detailed test cases based on project requirements and user stories. Perform functional, UI/UX, regression, cross‑browser, and cross‑device testing for web and mobile platforms. Conduct sanity and smoke testing before deployments to ensure core functionality is stable.
   

  

 Bug Reporting \& Validation Report bugs and issues using QA tools such as Jira, Trello, or ClickUp, including clear steps, screenshots, and environment details. Verify fixes in follow‑up testing cycles and ensure defects are properly closed. Maintain a structured approach to re‑testing, regression suites, and release sign‑off.
   

  

 Website \& eCommerce Testing Test websites built on WordPress, Magento, Shopify, and custom frameworks, validating both frontend and backend behavior. Validate responsive layouts, mobile browser compatibility, and device‑specific behavior for all major devices and browsers. Test core flows such as navigation, forms, checkout, user accounts, and multi‑step processes.
   

  

 Mobile App Testing Conduct Android and iOS app testing using real devices as well and emulators/simulators. Test application installation, login flows, in‑app navigation, push notifications, and background processes. Verify API responses, offline behavior, crash reporting, and performance across different network conditions.
   

  

 Collaboration \& Documentation Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and UX designers to improve quality and user experience. Document test plans, test execution logs, QA sign‑off reports, and release summaries. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and align testing activities with sprint timelines and release goals.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications3–4 years of professional QA experience in testing websites, web applications, and mobile apps. Strong proficiency in writing test cases, bug reports, and QA documentation. Familiarity with bug tracking and project management tools such as Jira, Trello, or ClickUp.
   

  

 Hands‑on experience in cross‑browser and responsive testing across desktop and mobile browsers. Strong understanding of browser developer tools (Inspect Element, Console, Network tab, etc.). Basic knowledge of Agile/Scrum workflows and involvement in sprint‑based QA cycles.
   

  

 Platform \& Tool Familiarity WordPress Understanding of the admin dashboard and plugin/theme‑based structure. Ability to test custom forms, shortcodes, page builders, and WooCommerce checkout/user flows. Magento Familiarity with core eCommerce flows such as product catalog, layered navigation, cart, checkout, and user accounts.
   

  

 Basic understanding of the Magento admin panel for testing configuration and data‑driven scenarios. Shopify Experience testing product pages, carts, checkout, orders, and Shopify apps. Awareness of Liquid template basics and how theme changes affect UI and functionality.

**About Oizom** 


 Oizom builds environmental monitoring hardware and software — air quality, noise, vibration, and gas\-sensing products deployed in the field across multiple markets. Our product line spans Polludrone (ambient air quality), Sonicbot (Class 1 noise monitoring), Seismibot (ground vibration), OGS (electrochemical gas sensing), Sensorbox, and AirOwl (our open\-source ESP32\-based air quality monitor). Our R\&D team spans Industrial Design, Design Engineering, Embedded Hardware, and Embedded Firmware.
 



**Role Summary** 


 We're hiring a Senior Firmware Engineer to lead our embedded firmware team. This is a hybrid role: roughly half hands\-on architecture and development across our MCU and embedded\-Linux product lines, and half technical leadership — mentoring junior engineers, setting coding and review standards, and owning firmware delivery across multiple concurrent product programs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

**Technical leadership** 



* Lead and mentor a team of 3–5 junior/mid firmware engineers — code reviews, design reviews, and hands\-on pairing
* Own firmware architecture decisions across product lines and make the build\-vs\-buy, framework, and platform calls
* Set and enforce firmware coding standards, version control practices, and release processes
* Plan and track firmware workstreams against product timelines; report status to the Head of R\&D



**Hands\-on development** 



* Develop and maintain firmware for ESP32/ESP32\-S3\-based products (sensor readout, connectivity, power management)
* Develop and maintain firmware for STM32\-based products (bare\-metal or RTOS, sensor interfacing, real\-time measurement paths)
* Build and maintain Python\-based firmware/application software for Raspberry Pi CM4\-based products (config\-driven sensor drivers, Modbus/serial interfacing, BLE, edge processing)
* Containerize and deploy services using Docker (on\-device services and supporting cloud/data pipelines)
* Implement and debug communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, MQTT, BLE
* Work closely with Embedded Hardware and Design Engineering on bring\-up, debugging, and DFM feedback loops


**Required Skills \& Experience** 
* 6–9 years of professional embedded firmware development experience, including at least 1–2 years in a lead or mentoring capacity
* Strong C/C\+\+ firmware development on
 
**ESP32** 

 (Arduino or ESP\-IDF) and
 
**STM32** 

 (bare\-metal or an RTOS such as FreeRTOS)
* Strong
 
**Python 3** 

 for embedded Linux application/firmware work on
 
**Raspberry Pi CM4** 

 or similar SBCs
* Practical experience with
 
**Docker** 

 — containerizing device\-side services and/or supporting data pipelines
* Solid grasp of embedded communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, and at least one of RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, or MQTT
* Hands\-on experience with wireless/cellular connectivity:
 
**Quectel 4G/LTE modules** 

 (AT command interfacing),
 
**LoRa** 

 ,
 
**WiFi** 

 , and
 
**BLE** 

 stacks
* Comfortable with hardware\-level debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, reading schematics and datasheets
* Git\-based version control and structured code review practices
* Demonstrated ability to lead a small team — planning work, unblocking others, and maintaining code quality without micromanaging


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience with sensor\-heavy or field\-deployed IoT products (environmental, industrial, or similar harsh\-environment hardware)
* Experience with cellular modules (e.g., Telit/Quectel LTE) and connectivity recovery/watchdog design
* Familiarity with a self\-hosted data stack (e.g., MQTT broker, Telegraf/InfluxDB/Grafana) for device telemetry
* Exposure to analog front\-end or electrochemical/gas\-sensing signal chains
* Experience with BLE peripheral/central firmware
* Prior experience in a startup or small\-team R\&D environment where you owned outcomes end\-to\-end
